description: This file defines the ThemeImage class in the OrangeHRM project's CorporateBranding plugin. The class models a theme image with properties like content, filename, file type, and size, providing methods for accessing these properties, serialization to array, and creation from array.

classes.name: ThemeImage
classes.description: Models an image with content, filename, type, and size, with methods for accessing properties and serialization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a ThemeImage object with content, filename, file type, and file size.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the content of the image, converting resource to string if needed.

methods.name: getFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename of the image.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns the file type of the image.

methods.name: getFileSize
methods.description: Returns the file size of the image.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if all properties of the image are null.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes the image properties into an associative array.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: Creates a ThemeImage instance from an associative array.
